paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -6.12% on average, with FTSE 100 strongest (-5.09%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-7.70%). Brent crude changed -6.86% to 89.27. Gold changed -8.13% to 3,570.2. Bitcoin changed -5.94% to 61,422.8789. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.052%, a relative move of -1.00%. Among the firms tracked, Freeport-McMoRan (-18.74%) and BHP (-14.86%) moved the most.
